problem_type: World-space interaction data is persisted or rendered in an incompatible scene/parent coordinate frame
symptom: Character/box previews commit at different positions in transformed scenes; nested-group paths do not follow pointer/grid; transformed camera models disagree with POV/preview/capture/recording.
direct_cause: Pointer and view APIs produce world coordinates but callers write them directly into scene-local/parent-local fields; rendering camera and path data omits the reverse conversion.
class_root: Every interaction crossing world and persisted local spaces must convert at a shared frame boundary, preserving position, orientation and dimensions.
affected_population: Scenes with global translation, rotation or scale
POV, mobile camera, camera capture and recorded motion
internal_only_reason: The repository declares object coordinates parent-local and camera coordinates scene-local while ViewportApi is world-space. Real three.Matrix4 composition is used as the independent regression oracle; this is an application coordinate contract, not a dependency feature.
invariants: Persisted transforms and waypoints stay in their declared scene/parent coordinate space
Ghost/preview world transforms equal the final entity/camera world transforms
World gridHeight remains the path ground height even in a transformed scene
Free view and mobile ViewportApi stay world-space
Viewport and output labels share the local head anchor transformed through the complete scene/parent hierarchy.
All target-relative camera consumers evaluate the complete target hierarchy in scene coordinates; character head and target enter the existing gaze solver in the same character frame.
generality_proof: All creation producers use shared sceneObjectGraph frames; camera producers/consumers share transformCameraPose with the same scene frame and inverse. Thus forward rendering and inverse interaction transforms are paired across all scanned entrances.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Convert a logical YXZ camera pose across an arbitrary scene coordinate frame
Resolve scene and parent chain for path writeback and world ghost coordinates
Return a visible character head world anchor from its actual object transform
Compose target and ancestor poses at the requested time into one scene-space frame for live cameras, baked closeups and character gaze

same_class_entry_points.evidence: World placement TRS converted to scene local
World box dimensions and bottom position converted together
World pointer seeds converted to entity parent space
Scene camera data and world view APIs use reciprocal conversion
Parent chain applied to nested object trajectory geometry
Live closeup/look-at/follow use target scene position and composed forward heading
Baked closeup target samples use the same complete animated hierarchy as live playback
Camera/object targets are transformed from scene to world, then head and target are both solved in character coordinates without changing the bone algorithm

recurrence.reason: Every interaction crossing world and persisted local spaces must convert at a shared frame boundary, preserving position, orientation and dimensions.
same_class_scan: Read scene global container, object parent hierarchy, both creation ghosts and all three creation hooks
Read trajectory visuals, PIP and capture pipeline for forward counterpart conversion
Both label producers share the complete localToWorld head anchor; output projection runs before auxiliary ancestor visibility is restored.

Audited live camera closeup/lookAt/follow, closeup baking, and character gaze after detecting parent-local target data consumed as scene/world coordinates; 5 camera and 2 gaze red tests reproduce the class.

prevention.invariant: Persisted transforms and waypoints stay in their declared scene/parent coordinate space; Ghost/preview world transforms equal the final entity/camera world transforms; World gridHeight remains the path ground height even in a transformed scene; Free view and mobile ViewportApi stay world-space
prevention.failure_mode: Reject singular frame inversion; do not silently reinterpret world data as local.
prevention.strategy: All creation producers use shared sceneObjectGraph frames; camera producers/consumers share transformCameraPose with the same scene frame and inverse. Thus forward rendering and inverse interaction transforms are paired across all scanned entrances.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove direct world-to-local assignment and incomplete parent/render frame interpretation in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Shared coordinate conversion remains pure matrix mathematics; three appears only in rendering consumers and test oracles.

migration: No data schema change; existing scene-local/parent-local fields retain their declared meaning. No guessing or rewriting historical authored data.
residual_risks: No automatic rewriting of historical projects authored under prior coordinate bugs; existing fields keep their declared local-space meaning.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/model/cameraCoordinateSpace.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
